title: Deception, uncaught
watchFor: Same opening as deception-caught, but every check is forced low. Vex must NOT notice the lie: she believes Oria or stays quiet. Oria's lie still shows her tell on the page, so a reader could catch it even though Vex didn't. Compare side by side with deception-caught.
turns: So, Oria, who's the client, really?
Brask, you've gone quiet. What do you make of this?
